text:
aroo: Heads-up: product launch on May 6. Need a compact creative set for launch comms + webinar preview. Minimum deliverables: 1) benchmark hero (single panel, big stat area + 3 micro-tiles), 2) two social tiles (one on economics, one on latency), 3) modular slide template (title + 3 bullets + chart placeholder), 4) animated micro-tile GIF for story. Also require EN/FR localized exports. Can someone take design + production?

ben: I can lead visuals. Quick Q: do we use the new neutral background or keep white? And which accent token for charts?

aroo: Use neutral-50 for hero background, white cards. Chart accent should be accent-600. Follow the latest brand tokens in Figma (page "Launch - May").

claire: Copy side: I'll draft short headlines for the three tiles. Prefer tight, mobile-first lines.

claire: Draft copy: 1) "Lower unit cost, higher throughput" 2) "Sub-second median latency" 3) "Seamless rollouts across environments". Keeping it punchy, no absolutes.

ben: Nice. Tile layout idea: stacked (icon above headline) for mobile readability. Micro-tiles at 360x200, hero 1200x628. Socials 1200x1200 + story 1080x1920. GIF 500x280, loop, 2s total duration.

aroo: Good. Localization: FR & DE. Claire can you provide strings by Tue noon? If phrasing tight, include alternatives.

claire: Yep — I'll add EN/FR/DE into /docs/launch/copy_v1.md and post here when ready.

design-bot: Reminder: filename convention: <product>_<asset>_<lang>_<size>_<v>.png. Eg: inference_hero_en_1200x628_v1.png. Also attach a copy deck to /docs/launch for legal review.

ben: I'll build v1 frames in Figma and upload to page "Review - May Launch" by EOD Mon. Lina (Ops), can you handle batch exports once I drop the manifest?

aroo: Lina OOO but she asked me to route exports through design-ops channel. If you include the manifest in the Figma comment, ops will pick it up.

ben: Confirming exports manifest format in comment:
Exports:
- inference_hero_en_1200x628_v1.png
- inference_tile1_en_360x200_v1.png
- inference_social_econ_en_1200x1200_v1.png
- inference_story_tiles_en_1080x1920_v1.gif

claire: Note for FR/DE we may need slightly taller tiles for wrapping. Ben, please allow 10px extra vertical padding on tiles.

ben: noted. Accessibility: design-bot, set contrast check on hero stat bar >=4.5:1?

design-bot: Affirmative. Use accent-700 for stat bar if contrast fails. Also run the a11y plugin before final export and include screenshot in Figma comment.

aroo: Legal review scheduled Wed 9am. Can we have v1 exports by Tue 5pm? Need time for legal + internal sales review.

ben: I'll upload v1 Figma frames by Tue 3pm to be safe and add exports manifest.

claire: Copy deck link will be /docs/launch/copy_v1.md. I'll include translation notes and short alternates.

ben: One more ask: can we include a simplified one-slide explainer (PNG) that summarizes the benchmark (1-line thesis + 3 bullets + tiny chart) for sales one-pager? Size 1024x576. Tagged in manifest.

aroo: Approved. Add to checklist: 1) v1 Figma frames uploaded, 2) exports manifest in comment, 3) copy deck attached, 4) animation gif exported, 5) asset filenames follow convention, 6) screenshots of a11y checks.

claire: I'll post translations by Tue noon.

ben: Starting comps now. Will ping here if I hit blockers. :rocket:
